combinedCost.note: The still's actual charge is not inferred; use the existing Pilot-02 terminal ledger result. Human-accepted values are review limits only and are not enforced by fal.

risks.detail: The model page lists per-second billing but no provider-enforced request spending cap. Actual duration/charge can differ from target.
The official schema takes num_frames but does not take requested duration or FPS; five seconds is a target, not a guaranteed output property.
Container, codec, dimensions, FPS, frame count, actual duration and audio stream must be probed.
Commercial-use labeling is not treated as an ownership grant. Separate request-specific human risk acceptance is required.
Card continuity, natural hand motion, banker typing, static framing and absence of morphing require human inspection.
A failed or ambiguous submission consumes the sole proposed animation slot; no retry or fallback.

stopConditions: Do not submit without separate signed ANIMATION_ONLY authorization and a one-request reservation.
Stop before submission if verified current pricing, endpoint, model or parameters drift from this package.
Stop if actual charge information exceeds the separately accepted exposure.
Stop without retry if submission fails or its outcome is ambiguous.
Reject invalid media or any unresolved technical metadata.
Keep output isolated and permanently ineligible for production readiness.
